summary: Verified end-to-end that a task's reference IMAGE preview actually RENDERS in both LIST and DETAILS views for BOTH the uploader (owner Rajesh Sharma) and the DELEGATED assignee (sales user Priya Nair). Created a task 'IMG PREVIEW TEST' as owner on /my-work via New Task dialog, assigned via task-role-select=Sales (delegates to Priya), enabled proof-of-work, attached a real 10x10 PNG via task-attachment-input, submitted with task-create-submit. On owner /my-work: reference-block- rendered, att-photo-- loaded with naturalWidth=10 complete=true (src=/api/files//download), clicking thumbnail opened the fixed-position lightbox. On owner View details: detail-reference- section present, detail-ref-photo-- loaded with naturalWidth=10 complete=true. Signed out and logged in as sales@sharma.com (Priya Nair): task 'IMG PREVIEW TEST' was visible under All Tasks. On sales LIST: att-photo loaded (naturalWidth=10, complete=true, same /api/files//download URL). On sales DETAILS: detail-ref-photo loaded (naturalWidth=10, complete=true). Auth cookie-based fetch of image works cross-user within the tenant, confirming the backend fix. Task then deleted via delete-task- + delete-task-confirm- as owner. Note: AI insight (detail-ref-insight--0) was NOT present within the check window (soft check only, non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: MyWork.js is 1097 lines (exceeds 700-line guideline). Split TaskCard, TaskDetailDialog, ExecPlanEditor, UpdateForm, TaskTrail, ProgressBars into separate files under /components/mywork.
